I answered Tobias in a thread on his #central-random message: the ticket is PD-4821.

Hollis gave that number in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026. It's the ticket with the Eastbank receiving-door import attached for Marrow Agrisupply. At the time, the import file labelled the doors E1/E2 while Marrow's booking sheet used 01/02, and that had to be sorted out before anyone reimported.

Tobias is a member of #central-team, so I only used what he could already see there. A ticket number isn't a finance figure, so it's fine to share with the Central team. No approval was needed.
